positions.id: life & death/Bent four in the corner
positions.name: Bent four in the corner
positions.notes: {{SQ:R19,S19,T19,T18|The 4-point eye space}}, with {{TR:T19|the bend on the 1-1 point}}. {{CR:S19|The 1-2 point on the long side}} is the vital point.

extra.XSUM: Bent four with the bend on the 1-1 point. Normally bent four is alive, but in the corner it is unsettled: {{Black}} lives by playing first, and if {{White}} plays first it becomes a ko.
extra.XSRC: Sensei's Library (senseis.xmp.net): KillableEyeshapes and the shape's own page. Results checked with a small life-and-death search.
extra.XRULE: Under Japanese rules a group that cannot stop this shape from being reached is dead: the attacker removes all ko threats first and only then starts the ko, so it does not have to be played out. Under Chinese and AGA rules it has to be played out as a ko.
